name: @branchleft/hetzner-host
comment: @pulumi/hcloud is a peerDependency, pinned exactly rather than caret-ranged: the default provider's version is part of every resource's URN, so a consumer resolving a different version than the one this package's own resources use would put one topology behind two provider instances. A peerDependency turns that mismatch into an install-time error instead of a silently nested second copy.
